transcript.speaker: LOCAL
transcript.text: Thanks for joining, Dana and Marcus. Today I'd like to agree how the Seeshell pilot runs at Acme.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_00
transcript.text: Great. We have twenty people lined up from the support team for the pilot.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_01
transcript.text: On my side, IT needs to approve the install before anyone gets it.

transcript.speaker: LOCAL
transcript.text: Understood. How long does an IT approval usually take?

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_01
transcript.text: About a week, if the security questionnaire is complete.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_00
transcript.text: So let's decide now: the pilot starts on November 17 with the twenty support people.

transcript.speaker: LOCAL
transcript.text: Agreed, November 17 it is.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_01
transcript.text: Then I need the security questionnaire back by this Friday, November 6.

transcript.speaker: LOCAL
transcript.text: I'll send the completed security questionnaire to Marcus by Friday.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_00
transcript.text: I'll put together the list of pilot users and share it by Monday.

transcript.speaker: LOCAL
transcript.text: Perfect. Seeshell records locally, so no audio leaves the laptops.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_01
transcript.text: That's the main thing our legal team will ask about.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_00
transcript.text: One worry: our support team is on calls back to back, so they may forget to start recordings.

transcript.speaker: LOCAL
transcript.text: Seeshell can start recording by itself when a call begins, so that should help.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_00
transcript.text: Good, but if adoption is low in the first week the pilot could stall.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_01
transcript.text: What about the Salesforce integration, is that in scope for the pilot?

transcript.speaker: LOCAL
transcript.text: I don't know yet. I need to check with our engineering team.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_00
transcript.text: Let's leave that open for now.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_01
transcript.text: Also, do we need a separate data processing agreement for the pilot?

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_00
transcript.text: Nobody here can answer that today. Let's ask legal.

transcript.speaker: LOCAL
transcript.text: I'll set up a training session for the support team the week of the 17th.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_00
transcript.text: Great. Who runs the training?

transcript.speaker: LOCAL
transcript.text: I'll run it myself. About thirty minutes.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_01
transcript.text: I'll need admin access to the Seeshell dashboard for IT.

transcript.speaker: LOCAL
transcript.text: Sure, I'll create an admin account for you.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_00
transcript.text: Let's meet again next week, same time, to check progress.

transcript.speaker: LOCAL
transcript.text: Sounds good. I'll send the invite for the weekly sync.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_01
transcript.text: And I'll confirm the IT approval timeline once I see the questionnaire.

transcript.speaker: REMOTE_00
transcript.text: Thanks both. This was really useful.

transcript.speaker: LOCAL
transcript.text: Thanks, talk next week.

summary: Kickoff call with Dana and Marcus from Acme about the Seashell pilot. Everyone agreed the pilot starts on November 17 with twenty people from Acme's support team. IT has to approve the install first, which usually takes about a week once the security questionnaire is complete, so Marcus needs the questionnaire by Friday, November 6. Dana will share the list of pilot users by Monday. Our side will set up and run a 30-minute training the week of the 17th, create an admin account on the dashboard for Marcus, and send the invite for a weekly sync. Dana is worried that busy agents may forget to record and that low adoption in the first week could stall the pilot. Two questions are still open: whether the Salesforce integration is in scope, and whether a separate data processing agreement is needed.
